# Lux Auto Detail Services (dtailwash.com)

> Bilingual (English/Spanish) mobile car detailing marketplace serving Miami-Dade County, Florida. Customers book vetted, insured independent detailers who come to their home or office; contractors receive jobs and get paid through the platform.

## Company

- Brand: Lux Auto Detail Services
- Website: dtailwash.com
- Service area: Miami-Dade County — Hialeah, Little Havana, Doral, Brickell, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Kendall, Miami, Westchester, Sweetwater, Aventura, North Miami, Miami Gardens, Homestead, Cutler Bay, Pinecrest
- Languages: English and Spanish, fully bilingual site and booking flow
- Services: Mobile Car Detailing, Interior Car Detailing, Exterior Car Detailing, Ceramic Coating

## Pages

- [Homepage (English)](https://www.dtailwash.com/en): Overview of services, pricing, and booking
- [Homepage (Spanish)](https://www.dtailwash.com/es): Resumen de servicios, precios y reservas
- [Book a detail](https://www.dtailwash.com/en/booking/select): Start a booking
- [Contractors](https://www.dtailwash.com/en/contractors): Information for detailers who want to join the platform
- Service + location pages: https://www.dtailwash.com/en/[service]/[city] — e.g. /en/ceramic-coating/doral, /en/mobile-car-detailing/kendall
